feature: 多图参考 · 修复重试
claim_level: 公众号索引标题；沿用上游Krea2接法探索
prompt: Replace only the orange cat in image 1 with the EXACT red fox from image 2, seated at the SAME location on the right side beside the glass cafe door. The fox faces the viewer as in image 2: narrow long muzzle, large pointed ears, bright detailed eyes, white cheeks and chest, orange fur, black forelegs, long bushy white-tipped tail. Keep the fox head clearly lit by warm cafe light, not black. Its paws rest directly on the ordinary concrete step. No forest, no moss, no rock. Keep all rainy night background, glass, red neon reflections and framing of image 1.
expected: 同时采用雨街背景和参考狐狸主体。
retry_reason: 只将两路 VAE 参考降至 384 后完成 512 输出。正面狐狸清楚，但苔石仍污染咖啡馆前景、右边残留原主体重影，身份也有差异；执行成功，合成质量部分达到。
runtime_profile: Encoding → isolated sampling → CPU decode; exact archived tensors, explicit workflow parameters
timing_scope: Sum of encoding, sampling and decoding submission-to-history times; excludes cold starts
